A real captured fixture is produced by the opt-in live test (--include-live). The implementer must produce this shape from a live GDELT fetch. Values here are test sentinels — NOT hardcoded producer outputs.
_note: GDELT JSONFeed 'articles' array; each article carries url (clickable), title, seendate (ISO-ish), language, domain, sourcecountry. Tone is a float in [-100, 100] range from a separate API mode (ContextualWeb/tone endpoint). The producer must surface tone in the payload and url+seendate per article in sources.
